item.title: Music Beneath the Radio Calls

turns.text: Add a tense instrumental bed to this. Keep it under the radio calls so every word is easy to hear, especially 'Rook, you with me?' Don't change the footage.

item.tests: Tests whether added music remains audibly subordinate to the original speech, with intelligibility preserved throughout the delivered video.

answer_sheet.Music mood and vocals: Tense instrumental music, with no singing.
answer_sheet.Music level relative to speech: Clearly quieter than the radio calls whenever someone speaks; every original word must remain easy to hear.
answer_sheet.Source footage, duration, and framing: Keep the entire attached 7-second cockpit clip, with unchanged visuals, timing, and framing.
answer_sheet.Speech and added text: Keep the original radio-call recording in sync. Do not replace it or add text.

must_haves: The output preserves all seven seconds of the original cockpit footage without visual changes or extra shots.
A tense instrumental music bed is audible, with no added singing.
The original radio calls remain present and synchronized, including the clearly intelligible line 'Rook, you with me?'
During every spoken line, the music is perceptibly below the voice and does not mask words with loud beats, swells, or accents.
The music is not simply muted for the entire clip; it is audible while remaining subordinate to speech.

turns.text: Add a tense instrumental bed to this. Keep it under the radio calls so every word is easy to hear, especially 'Rook, you with me?' Don't change the footage.

dialog.agent:
I can create a tense instrumental track, but the connected Magic Hour tools can’t mix it into your video while preserving the footage and original radio audio. I won’t use a video-generation tool that could alter the footage.

For the mix, keep the music low beneath all radio calls and duck it further around **“Rook, you with me?”** so every word stays clear.

If you’d like a separate instrumental bed to add in an editor, tell me the clip’s duration.
dialog.why: It says the connected tools cannot mix music into the video while preserving the footage and original audio. The request for duration is only for an alternative separate instrumental track.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings don’t remove the limitation: these tools can’t add music beneath the existing radio audio without potentially changing the video.

I can generate a **separate tense instrumental bed at 1 credit per second**, but I need the clip’s duration first. Your footage and radio calls would remain untouched.
dialog.why: It requests the clip’s duration before generating a separate instrumental bed and waits for that information.
dialog.user: The clip is 7 seconds. Yes, go ahead.

dialog.agent:
The music generator has a **15-second minimum**, so it can’t produce exactly 7 seconds. I can generate a separate 15-second tense instrumental for **15 credits**, which you can trim to 7 seconds in your editor.

Shall I make that? It won’t be mixed into or change your footage.
dialog.why: It asks the user to approve generating a 15-second instrumental for 15 credits and waits for confirmation.

turns.agent: Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits for the **15-credit minimum**. No music was created, and your footage and radio audio are unchanged.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: A restrained tense instrumental underscore for a seven-second scene of radio communication, delivered as a 15-second music-only track for trimming. Begin immediately with quiet, low sustained synth drones and subtle sparse pulses, a sense of uncertainty and suspense. No vocals, no speech, no radio effects, no percussion hits, no dramatic risers, no loud accents. Minimal midrange content to leave ample space for intelligible radio dialogue, especially the line 'Rook, you with me?' Keep dynamics even, subtle, subdued and unobtrusive throughout; no big climax. Suitable to be mixed very quietly under existing dialogue. Do not include or recreate any dialogue.
